description: This file defines the DbConnectionValidator class responsible for validating database connections and schemas within the OrchardCore project, supporting multiple database providers and checking for specific table schemas.

classes.name: DbConnectionValidator
classes.description: A class that validates database connections and schemas for different database providers within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously validates the database connection and schema, checking for required tables and documents.

methods.name: GetDocumentCommandText
methods.description: Constructs SQL command text to retrieve specific documents from the database.

methods.name: GetFactoryAndSqlDialect
methods.description: Returns the appropriate connection factory and SQL dialect based on the database provider.

methods.name: GetSqlBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new SqlBuilder instance with the specified dialect, prefix, and separator.
